instructions.core_directive:
Use case: Blast radius of a db01 outage.

Use the `ask` intent tool with this question in plain language against the seeded CMDB and TRM data (records labelled `[orch-test]`). Use `find` first when you need the class or source names. Do not query ServiceNow directly.

Expected path: Up from db01: Billing Engine and Reporting are hosted on it; Customer Billing and Supply Chain depend on them; owners Finance Apps and Supply Chain Ops.

A correct answer: 2 applications, 2 business services, 2 owner groups. Payments and Online Ordering are not affected. It names the source of each fact and says plainly when the seed data is not present in the instance.
